data.title: 小鞠知花 · 雨天公交站的衣角紧抓
data.description: 淅淅沥沥的暴雨公交站台下，气温微凉。冻得缩紧脖子的知花小心翼翼地伸手拽住你的外套衣角，被你一把拉进怀里共用围巾时，娇小身躯微颤，幸福地靠在你的胸膛上。
data.location: rustic countryside bus shelter surrounded by rain and green trees
data.action: tugging partner coat hem in cold rain, pulled into a warm embrace sharing an umbrella, smiling shyly with misty grateful eyes
data.lighting: cool rainy atmosphere illuminated by warm bus shelter lantern
data.mood: rainy day tenderness, cozy protective warmth, sweet helpless affection
data.promptProse: Under a rainy bus stop shelter, petite Chika Komari is pulled into partner coat embrace, smiling shyly with flushed cheeks and misty eyes.
data.animaCaption: Chika Komari sharing umbrella warmth happily at rainy bus stop.
